walkthroughs.title: Get Started with KitabuCode
walkthroughs.description: Set up your mobile development environment

steps.title: Choose your theme
steps.description:
Pick a color theme that suits your style.

[Browse Color Themes](command:workbench.action.selectTheme)

steps.title: Your development tools
steps.description:
KitabuCode comes with everything you need to start coding:

$(check) **Node.js** + npm: ready

$(check) **Python** + pip: ready

$(check) **Git**: ready

$(check) **make**: ready

**Java 17** and **Ruby** install on demand. Touch and hold the KitabuCode icon on your home screen and pick **Manage toolchains**.

[Got It](command:kitabucode.welcome.toolsDismissed)

steps.title: A powerful terminal
steps.description:
Open a full bash terminal with every bundled tool on PATH: ``node``, ``python3``, ``git``, ``npm``.

``node -e 'console.log("hi")'`` prints ``hi``

``python3 -c 'print("hi")'`` prints ``hi``

``git init demo`` prints ``Initialized empty Git repository``

[Open Terminal](command:workbench.action.terminal.new)

steps.title: Extend with more features
steps.description:
Install extensions from the Open VSX marketplace for language support, themes, and tools.

Extensions written in JavaScript work. The few that bundle a program compiled for desktop Linux can install without complaint and then do nothing, with no error on screen.

[Browse Extensions](command:workbench.view.extensions)
